description: Use when testing a web application for SQL injection on an authorized engagement. Covers detection and confirmation probes, UNION-based extraction, boolean and time-based blind techniques, error-based extraction, second-order injection, and sqlmap 1.9.2 automation plus full manual fallback when automation is blocked. Use when login forms, search boxes, URL parameters, cookies, or API inputs look injectable, or when a scan flags a possible database error.
